info.title: Eternet Test Planner
info.description: Dotnet tool for planning affected test selections from repository changes.

commands.name: prepare

options.name: --cache-directory

commands.name: ci
commands.description: Compose a versioned CI planning or build receipt for the current repository.

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Resolve one CI planning receipt using the in-process ETP orchestration flow.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Repository workspace path. [default: <path>]

options.name: --base-ref
options.description: Base git ref used to discover the CI diff.

options.name: --head-ref
options.description: Head git ref used to discover the CI diff.

options.name: --output
options.description: Optional JSON output path for the ci-plan receipt.

options.name: --summary-output
options.description: Optional plain-text summary output path.

options.name: --github-output
options.description: Optional GitHub Actions key=value output path.

options.name: --analysis-depth
options.description: Analysis depth: fast-project, balanced, semantic, or deep. [default: semantic]

options.name: --cache-directory
options.description: Enable persistent analysis cache using this directory.

options.name: --no-cache
options.description: Disable persistent analysis cache reads and writes. [default: False]

options.name: --cache-required
options.description: Fail when the expected cache entry cannot be read. [default: False]

options.name: --test-duration-baseline
options.description: Optional etp-test-durations baseline used by the planner.

options.name: --scope
options.description: Optional solution, project, or lane manifest that bounds graph discovery and cache inputs.

options.name: --build-impact-root
options.description: Portable compiler-produced impact-index root. CI consults it before loading Roslyn and widens conservatively when it is unavailable or invalid.

options.name: --test-inventory
options.description: Repository-contained per-project SDK/TFM inventory evaluated out of process.

options.name: --build-impact-overlay
options.description: Validated certified or nonpublishable current-head overlay produced from the exact build-impact root.

options.name: --build-impact-prepare-manifest
options.description: Exact etp.prepare.v2 identity required when consuming a nonpublishable current-head overlay.

options.name: --partition-count
options.description: Number of partitions to produce when a real selection exists. [default: 1]

options.name: --partition-settings
options.description: Workspace-relative or absolute PartitionSettings JSON. Class sharding remains fail-closed unless this explicitly authorizes a complete project inventory.

options.name: --force-full
options.description: Return a full-suite CI receipt without running the normal selection algorithm. [default: False]

options.name: --refresh
options.description: Refresh planner inputs and emit an explicit refresh CI outcome. [default: False]

options.name: --project-impact-fallback-signal-threshold
options.description: Number of project-impact budget signals required before widening to candidate test projects.

options.name: --planner-p95-ms
options.description: Historical planner p95 used by total-cost decisions.

options.name: --economic-process-startup-ms
options.description: Estimated process startup cost included in total-cost decisions.

options.name: --economic-min-saving-ms
options.description: Minimum estimated net saving required by total-cost decisions.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Run a disposable ETP CI build and emit a canonical receipt.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Repository workspace path. [default: <path>]

options.name: --graph
options.description: Optional disposable .slnx graph path. If omitted, the command materializes one from --project values.

options.name: --project
options.description: Selected project path. Repeat or provide multiple values to materialize a disposable graph when --graph is absent. [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --run-root
options.description: Optional isolated ETP run root. Defaults to a timestamped child of .etp/ci-build under the workspace.

options.name: --work-root
options.description: Optional dedicated root for ETP ephemeral graph, run, output, and receipt files. May be outside the workspace.

options.name: --output-root
options.description: Optional output root for build artifacts. Defaults to a child of the run root.

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Build configuration. [default: Release]

options.name: --receipt-output
options.description: Optional path for the outgoing CiBuildReceipt JSON. Defaults to a receipt inside the run root.

options.name: --msbuild-property
options.description: MSBuild property argument forwarded to restore and build, for example /p:Name=Value. [default: System.String[]]

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Plan affected test selections.

options.name: --workspace
options.description: Repository workspace path. [default: <path>]

options.name: --base-ref
options.description: Base git ref. Defaults to the working tree placeholder in P1-W1.

options.name: --head-ref
options.description: Head git ref. Defaults to the working tree placeholder in P1-W1.

options.name: --output
options.description: Optional output JSON path.

options.name: --analysis-depth
options.description: Analysis depth: fast-project, balanced, semantic, or deep. [default: fast-project]

options.name: --cache-directory
options.description: Enable persistent analysis cache using this directory. Cache is disabled unless this is set or --cache-required is used.

options.name: --no-cache
options.description: Disable persistent analysis cache reads and writes. [default: False]

options.name: --cache-required
options.description: Fail when a cache entry cannot be read instead of recomputing. Intended for advanced diagnostics. [default: False]

options.name: --test-duration-baseline
options.description: Optional etp-test-durations baseline, JSON or MessagePack, used for cost-aware selection budgets.

options.name: --scope
options.description: Optional solution, project, or lane manifest that bounds graph discovery and cache inputs.

options.name: --build-impact-root
options.description: Portable build-impact artifact from a previous trusted build, used to refine the plan before building.

options.name: --max-roslyn-projects
options.description: Maximum Roslyn projects loaded before widening to candidate scope.

options.name: --max-semantic-elapsed-ms
options.description: Maximum cumulative semantic elapsed milliseconds before widening to candidate scope.

options.name: --max-graph-nodes
options.description: Maximum symbol graph nodes before widening to candidate scope.

options.name: --max-graph-edges
options.description: Maximum symbol graph edges before widening to candidate scope.

options.name: --max-changed-declarations-before-fallback
options.description: Maximum changed declarations before widening to candidate scope.

options.name: --max-cache-read-write-elapsed-ms
options.description: Maximum cumulative cache read/write elapsed milliseconds before widening to candidate scope.

options.name: --max-selected-methods-before-fallback
options.description: Maximum selected test methods before widening to candidate project scope. When method coverage is configured, both thresholds must be exceeded.

options.name: --max-selected-classes-before-fallback
options.description: Maximum selected test classes before widening to candidate project scope. When class coverage is configured, both thresholds must be exceeded.

options.name: --max-selected-method-coverage-before-fallback
options.description: Maximum selected test method coverage ratio, 0..1, before widening to candidate project scope or gating the selected-method count threshold.

options.name: --max-selected-class-coverage-before-fallback
options.description: Maximum selected test class coverage ratio, 0..1, before widening to candidate project scope or gating the selected-class count threshold.

options.name: --max-selected-test-duration-ms-before-fallback
options.description: Maximum estimated selected test duration in milliseconds before widening to candidate project scope. Requires --test-duration-baseline.

options.name: --max-selected-test-duration-ratio-before-fallback
options.description: Maximum estimated selected test duration divided by the full-suite baseline, 0..1, before widening to candidate project scope. Requires --test-duration-baseline.

options.name: --max-planner-and-selected-test-duration-ratio-before-fallback
options.description: Maximum estimated planner plus selected test duration divided by the full-suite baseline, 0..1, before widening. Requires --test-duration-baseline.

options.name: --unknown-test-duration-ms
options.description: Conservative duration assigned to each selected test with no baseline match.

options.name: --max-changed-files-before-project-fallback
options.description: Maximum changed files before skipping semantic analysis and widening to candidate project scope.

options.name: --max-runtime-changed-files-before-project-fallback
options.description: Maximum changed src/tests runtime files before contributing a project-impact fallback signal.

options.name: --max-project-input-files-before-project-fallback
options.description: Maximum changed project graph input files before skipping semantic analysis. When project-input ratio is configured, both thresholds must be exceeded.

options.name: --max-project-input-file-ratio-before-project-fallback
options.description: Maximum changed project graph input file ratio, 0..1, before skipping semantic analysis or gating the project-input count threshold.

options.name: --max-affected-projects-before-project-fallback
options.description: Maximum affected projects before skipping semantic analysis. When affected-project ratio is configured, both thresholds must be exceeded.

options.name: --max-affected-project-ratio-before-project-fallback
options.description: Maximum affected project ratio, 0..1, before skipping semantic analysis or gating the affected-project count threshold.

options.name: --max-candidate-test-projects-before-project-fallback
options.description: Maximum candidate test projects before skipping semantic analysis. When candidate-test ratio is configured, both thresholds must be exceeded.

options.name: --max-candidate-test-project-ratio-before-project-fallback
options.description: Maximum candidate test project ratio, 0..1, before skipping semantic analysis or gating the candidate-test count threshold.

options.name: --max-project-test-impact-edges-before-project-fallback
options.description: Maximum affected-project to candidate-test-project graph edges before skipping semantic analysis. When impact-edge ratio is configured, both thresholds must be exceeded.

options.name: --max-project-test-impact-edge-ratio-before-project-fallback
options.description: Maximum affected-project to candidate-test-project graph edge ratio, 0..1, before skipping semantic analysis or gating the impact-edge count threshold.

options.name: --max-tests-per-affected-project-before-project-fallback
options.description: Maximum candidate test projects triggered by one affected project before skipping semantic analysis and widening to candidate project scope.

options.name: --project-impact-fallback-signal-threshold
options.description: Number of project impact budget signals required before skipping semantic analysis. Defaults to 2.

options.name: --planner-p95-ms
options.description: Historical p95 planner cost used by the pre-semantic economic gate.

options.name: --economic-process-startup-ms
options.description: Estimated process startup/partition cost added to the pre-semantic economic gate.

options.name: --economic-min-saving-ms
options.description: Minimum required net saving for semantic planning to be eligible.
